correctness.rationale: Fixing one independently designated sample as anchor yields uniform Dirichlet(1,1,1) arc gaps and hence the labelled angle simplex. The affine map T acts by −1/2 on the two-dimensional tangent plane, has Jacobian 1/4 and bijects the full simplex to the strict acute central simplex; it transports the entire uniform law. Its doubly stochastic matrix implies T(x)≺x, strict for nonequilateral vectors; log-sin concavity proves normalized perimeter, area, inradius increases. Beta(1,2) integration gives E[P]=12/π and E[P|acute]=48/π², and centered scaling gives V|acute=d V/4. Independent rational-simplex inequalities over 406 sample triples and integral identity support the proof, not replace it.
